data.name: Coop Server Tools(Beta)
data.shortDescription: Allows for hiding maps, gps and indicators icons in coop. Tells a server host the modlist a client is using.
data.description:
This mod has 2 import features:

#### Shows you a list mods a client is using

If someone also has this mod and joins your server you will get a list of the mods they are using on the Redloader Console.

#### Allows you to disable player location indicators for everyone in coop.

This includes all maps, gps icons, player usernames etc. Your location can be truly secret. This is excellent if you want to do coop pvp.

#### How to use this mod

First find someone you trust to do coop with you. Tell them to install this mod. Once they are in game check the Redloader console that allows loads with the game. If they have this mod installed you should see something like:
[CoopServerTools] mysteamfriend has CoopServerTools installed!

Followed by a list of all mods they are using. You will also get a notification in game shortly after they join.

If you don't see their name show up it means they don't have it installed. If you see they are using a list of mods that you don't want used on the server at that point you can decide the appropriate action.

#### Can clients edit the settings?

Not if they have this mod installed. If they have this mod installed it will override any attempts to change the host settings. However if you see someone running Unity Explorer or GPSRemover tell them to remove it before the game continues.
